pb-influencer.title: Influencer campaigns
pb-influencer.help: Choose a campaign to plan creator work and compare actual results.
pb-influencer.empty: Create an influencer campaign order first.
pb-influencer.shortlistHelp: Add public profiles you chose. Chausar does not scrape profiles or send messages.
pb-influencer.name: Creator name
pb-influencer.contactHelp: Only add an email the creator published for business enquiries, with the page that shows it.
pb-influencer.disclosure: The brief requires a prominent #Ad disclosure under ASCI guidance. Professional review is required before publishing.
pb-influencer.paidLabel: Use the paid-partnership label where the platform offers it.
pb-influencer.outreachHelp: Approve a domain lookup and save an email in Leads. You send it yourself from your mailbox.
pb-influencer.draftSaved: The draft is in Leads. Nothing was sent.
pb-influencer.subject: Email subject
pb-influencer.priceHelp: This is a planning estimate from comparable posts and labelled assumptions. It is not an agreed fee.
pb-influencer.target: Owner target cost per signup in rupees
pb-influencer.comparableHelp: Add comparable posts with their actual publication time and observed views. Code uses the latest ten.
pb-influencer.clickRate: Expected clicks per ten thousand views
pb-influencer.signupRate: Expected signups per ten thousand clicks
pb-influencer.fit: Audience fit, ten thousand means no change
pb-influencer.competition: Competition adjustment, ten thousand means no change
pb-influencer.error.REQUEST_FAILED: The campaign could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
pb-influencer.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The campaign changed. Open it again before saving.
pb-influencer.error.INFLUENCER_PRICE_CAP: The estimate exceeds your cap. Review the assumptions or explicitly change your cap.
pb-influencer.error.LEADS_BLOCKED: This creator asked not to be contacted.
pb-influencer.error.LEADS_EMAIL_UNVERIFI: The email has no verified mail server. No draft was saved.
pb-influencer.error.LEADS_ADDRESS_MISSIN: Add your business postal address before drafting.
pb-influencer.error.INFLUENCER_CASE_NOT_: This campaign is no longer available. Choose an order again.
pb-influencer.group.creator: Creator search terms
pb-influencer.packetHelp: Review the saved shortlist, disclosures, prices and observed results. Exporting saves a file; you send it yourself.
pb-influencer.priceCheckFee: Your fee for this price check (rupees)
pb-influencer.error.INFLUENCER_PACKET_IN: Save an estimate, your fee and a disclosure brief for every creator first.
